As per the Karnataka Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 1994, the minor minerals used in works shall be compulsorily procured only from authorized minor mineral quarry contractors who have obtained permission from the Department of Mines and Geology, and the minerals shall be used only after obtaining a mineral transport permit. All departments/agencies executing works shall mandatorily comply with this.

The use of minor minerals transported from unauthorized sources and used in works is illegal. If minor minerals produced from unauthorized sources are used in works without a mineral transport permit, the work contractors bills shall not be settled. Only in cases where the contractor executing the work pays to the Department of Mines and Geology a penalty equal to five times the royalty for the minor minerals used in the work, an additional payment AP of 40% of the royalty, and 10% of the royalty towards the District Mineral Foundation Fund, and submits the relevant information, action shall be taken to settle the work bills.

itemList.description:
Mechanical Means -
Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all  works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical   specifications, including setting out,   shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting &  stacking the selected  earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils upto 300 mm depth

Providing  and  laying  in  Cement  Concrete    for  all  Basement  &  surface  level works,  return  walls,  retaining  walls,  sunken  floors  etc.  The    granite/trap/ basalt  crushed graded coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle  vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all   other   appurtenances    required to complete the work as per technical  specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates

Precast Cement Concrete Interlocking Blocks - Providing  and  laying  80mm  thick  factory  made  precast  M  -30 grade Cement Concrete  Paver Block as per IRC SP 63:2018 & IS 15658 for Commercial Traffic Axle load repetitions upto 10MSA &  for  Residential  Streets  of  approved  shape  and  colour,  laid  in required pattern and including over 40mm thick compacted bed of coarse sand, filling the joints with fine sand etc. all complete as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge. (WMM/WBM Base to be paid separately as per relevant technical specification). Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - IRC SP 63:2018

Manual Means -
Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating Each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.
